text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Development agency for Morocco's northern regions holds meeting over strategy to increase employment.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri meets party leaders over draft electoral law.
- Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes says position over referendum in Western Sahara remains unchanged.
- French trade minister postpones visit to Morocco because of differences over potential contracts.
